description: This file implements the 'Delete' feature for articles in a C# ASP.NET Core project. It defines the command, validation, and handler to delete an article identified by a slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the command's slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of an article based on the provided slug, including error handling if the article is not found.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes deletion of the article; finds the article by slug, throws an error if not found, otherwise removes it and saves changes.
